scope: Independent, source-linked verification of the published CS2 dashboard on 2026-10-26 (live capture at 00:51-00:54Z from a network-capable runner), the nine open Hotspawn fixtures the 23:03:48Z publication does not list, and the identity/clock conflicts that decide which external line may price them.
method: Every live fact below was fetched by .github/workflows/b3e91409-probe.yml and archived under data/research/b3e91409/live/ with its URL, UTC observation time, HTTP status, byte count and SHA-256 (manifest.json, sources.json). The published rows were re-derived offline from the inputs each row itself publishes by scripts/b3e91409_verify.py; the formulas are re-implemented there, not imported from the production ladder. No probability, pick, price or alias was written by this session: the live dossier only records observed prices and the printed rating formula. Hotspawn community '% picked' and HLTV fan votes were never read as inputs.

items.area: Coverage: nine open fixtures are absent from the published list
items.finding: The publication generated at 2026-10-25T23:03:48Z (origination.json, 23:04:02Z) lists 10 open fixtures. The same public Hotspawn fixture array read at 2026-10-26T00:51:22Z returns 81 CS2 records and 19 open fixtures, and the rendered lobby at the same instant shows the same 19 cards. The nine fixtures with no published row are 1079201 (INOX Division vs Nemesis, 09:00Z), 1079202 (FOKUS vs ex-Zero Tenacity, 12:00Z), 1081159 (LFO 10 vs ex-6666, 12:00Z), 1081160 (HAVU vs ILLYRIANS, 15:00Z), 1079203 (Metizport vs BRUTE, 15:00Z), 1093218 (Nuclear TigeRES vs UNiTY, 18:00Z), 1081162 (ex-RUSTEC vs Spirit Academy, 27 Oct 12:00Z), 1081163 (BakS vs Saint Sinners, 27 Oct 15:00Z) and 1081164 (Inner Circle Academy vs Lavked, 27 Oct 18:00Z). Each is a low-tier CCT Europe Series #12 or NODWIN Clutch Series #13 fixture, i.e. exactly the class the brief says must still receive a pick.
items.handling: The live dossier (data/research/b3e91409/live/analysis.json, summary.md) prices all 19 fixtures at 00:54Z from observed sources: 6 from a verified Polymarket series order book, 3 from a Thunderpick two-way line, and 10 from the printed HLTV-ranking Elo model. The nine missing ids are listed with their Hotspawn permalink and the source that can price each. Nothing is written into the publisher's own files by this session; the next successful refresh collects the same array, and scripts/b3e91409_verify.py re-runs the coverage comparison against whatever is published.

items.area: Provider clock conflict on 1079202 FOKUS vs ex-Zero Tenacity
items.finding: Polymarket event 1252125 (cs2-fokus-zerote-2026-10-26) stamps its full-series market 6186062 and both map markets with gameStartTime '2026-10-26 18:00:00+00'. Hotspawn schedules the fixture at 12:00Z, Thunderpick row 2888795 starts at 12:00Z, and HLTV match 2399117 starts at 12:00Z. The six-hour disagreement is far outside the 60-second identity window, so the Polymarket book cannot be joined; the fixture is priced from Thunderpick 1.35 / 2.90 instead (68.2% / 31.8% after proportional margin removal).
items.handling: No rule was relaxed. The published 60-second identity rule correctly refuses the Polymarket event; the conflict is recorded here so the owner of scripts/originate.py can decide whether Polymarket's start-time field is a known platform offset for this competition. The dossier's Thunderpick quote carries its own URL and observation time.

items.area: Identity alias is scoped to other competitions, so a live market is refused on 1079201
items.finding: For INOX Division vs Nemesis (NODWIN Clutch Series #13, 09:00Z) the Polymarket series market 6186053 quotes 0.72 / 0.73 bid/ask with outcomes ['Team Nemesis', 'INOX Division']. Hotspawn names the team 'Nemesis'. The reviewed registry has 'Team Nemesis' -> 'Nemesis' but its applies_to list covers only 'PGL Bucharest 2027: Closed Qualifier', 'PGL Bucharest 2027 Closed Qualifier' and 'CIS LAN Championship #9', so the join is correctly refused for this competition and no alias is invented here. The dossier therefore prices the fixture from HLTV ranking points (Nemesis #47 32 pts, INOX Division #84 10 pts) at 46.8% / 53.2%.
items.handling: Logged as a request for the owner of data/origination/aliases.json (session arena-500519ba, task 500A-2): add a competition-scoped alias for 'NODWIN Clutch Series #13' backed by the Polymarket event title, the Hotspawn fixture page and HLTV match 2399116, if that owner agrees the three records describe the same team. Until then the market stays unjoined and the model figure is labelled as a research model.

items.area: Two-sided but illiquid series book on 1081160 HAVU vs ILLYRIANS
items.finding: Polymarket event 1255952 (cs2-havu-ill4-2026-10-26) does carry a full-series moneyline (market 6231433) at the exact fixture start, but its order book quotes 0.05 / 0.95, a 0.90 spread; the published outcomePrices are 0.5 / 0.5 and bestBid/bestAsk are 0.05 / 0.95. A midpoint from that book would be a fabricated number, so the dossier refuses it and falls back to the HLTV-ranking model (HAVU 50.3% / ILLYRIANS 49.7%).
items.handling: No probability was derived from a one-sided or 0.90-wide book. The rejection is recorded with the CLOB URLs so a reviewer can see the empty book itself.

items.area: One fixture has no betting line anywhere in the sweep
items.finding: 1081159 LFO 10 vs ex-6666 (CCT Europe 2026 Series #12, 2026-10-26T12:00Z) appears in the Hotspawn array and in the lobby, and HLTV carries it as match 2399509 (BO3, 0 s start delta), but no Polymarket event and no Thunderpick row names both teams at the 00:51Z observation. Its only quantitative evidence is the HLTV world ranking (LFO 10 and ex-6666 both published), which yields 48.8% / 51.2% from the printed Elo formula. This is the single case of 19 where the pick exists only because of a rating model.
items.handling: The pick is published as a research model with its formula and points, not as a market line. If a bookmaker line appears before the lock, the next refresh will take it; no price is inferred from the absence of one.

items.area: A verified row publishes no limitation text beside a 0.10-wide single-market median
items.finding: Row 1082792 (HOTU vs The Huns) publishes method 'market', label 'Originated market line (Polymarket)', probabilities 87.0% / 13.0% and a quote whose bid/ask are 0.82-0.92 and 0.08-0.18, i.e. a 0.10 spread on a single venue. The two published numbers replay exactly from that quote (delta 0.0), but the analysis carries no limitations array, so the row does not tell the reader that the number is a single-market midpoint on a wide book. Every other published row carries its limitation text.
items.handling: Reported, not edited: the row belongs to the publisher's ladder. scripts/b3e91409_verify.py records it as a note and still verifies the arithmetic.
